correctness.rationale: For xRy, Euclideanness gives R(x)⊆R(y), while transitivity gives R(y)⊆R(x). Connectedness propagates the common successor set, which is nonempty by seriality; its members are reflexive and all other members of the frame are not. Boundedness therefore requires exactly that the source core map onto the target core, with no constraint on satellites. For a self-map the core is permuted. Inverse image preserves the modal operator exactly when it satisfies this boundedness condition, and its Boolean image consists of unions of fibers, giving size 2^{c+j}. Inclusion–exclusion counts the maps with a prescribed satellite image set; idempotents fix their entire image pointwise. Periodic vertices are precisely those in the eventual set image, and a prescribed periodic satellite set requires a permutation there and a forest attaching the other vertices to the periodic set. The reduced Laplacian is (n+r)I-J for n nonroots and r specified roots and has determinant r(n+r)^{n-1}; n=0 has one empty forest. The same supports follow from the idempotents, including s=0. The independent replay matched all three spectra in 21 frame cases through six worlds (296,675 function tables), 100 cross-size cases and 380 modal-preservation cases, including the stated three rows for (2,3). Files: /workspace/branches/5bad11d7-7e16-4b86-81fa-d3e7f0da4c58/independent_check.py and replay.txt. The supplied verifier was inspected, not executed; finite checks supplement the proof.

evidence: Given the known KD45 normal form, for prescribed image C∪J the j satellites must be hit, and the core sites hit by satellite sources can be any subset of size ell. Summing binom(c,ell) times the standard surjection count (j+ell)! S(s,j+ell) over ell, then multiplying by c! binom(s,j), is exactly the proposed E coefficient.

For fixed image C∪J, all retractions in the fixed-one-point model on c+s points (with the distinguished point in C) already fix all of C, giving exactly (c+j)^{s-j} without further filtering. The eventual coefficient is the direct prescribed-root specialization above. The cross-frame hom count is a surjection from C to D times a free function on S.

originality.rationale: The particular three-polynomial packaging in KD45 language was not found verbatim for c>1, but the proposed mathematical counts are direct specializations of the known connected-frame normal form and exact finite-map enumerators. In particular the c=1 triple is explicitly present for the identical underlying map action in e3fc79d02d42, the retraction coefficients for any c are a prescribed-image subcount of that very model, and the eventual counts for any c follow immediately from Pitman's prescribed cyclic-root census. The one-step and hom-set counts are direct ordinary surjection counts on prescribed subsets of a finite target. No additional constrained dynamics remain once the known normal form is substituted. This is an implication-based judgment, not a claim that a paper enumerating the exact monoid's full triple was retrieved. The failed focused web lookup was not used as evidence of coverage.

value.rationale: Image ranks are natural, but in this frame family the modal operator enforces only a setwise-preserved core. All three proposed counts then recover exact generic finite-map counts by the elementary reductions given above. Comparing ordinary and eventual ranks at five worlds illustrates the known distinction between image points and periodic points but does not uncover an additional invariant, structural constraint, or independently needed unknown exact fact. No valuable surviving claim was identified by dropping the already covered pieces.
